beats.say: In its first year, Coca-Cola sold just 9 drinks a day.
It was invented in 1886, by a pharmacist in Atlanta named John Pemberton.
A glass cost 5 cents, at Jacobs' Pharmacy.
His bookkeeper, Frank Robinson, named it, and wrote the famous logo by hand.
Pemberton sold his share, and died in 1888.
He never saw what it would become.
Today, the company sells over 2 billion drinks every single day.
From 9 drinks a day… to 2 billion.
